TimetableWorkspace.title: TimetableWorkspace
TimetableWorkspace.description: Complete school timetable state synced across all devices including teachers, classes, subjects, tahap period configurations, lesson cards, and scheduled sessions.

schoolName.description: School name displayed on timetable headers

lastGeneratedAt.description: Formatted timestamp string of the latest timetable generation

ownerId.description: UID of the creator who initialized the workspace

isSharedWorkspace.description: Whether this timetable workspace is shared across school devices with the workspace code

teachers.description: List of school teachers and their time-off constraints

classes.description: List of school classes (Tahap 1, 2, 3) and their time-off constraints

subjects.description: List of subjects, color themes, and subject time-off constraints

tahapConfigs.description: Time period slot configurations for Tahap 1, Tahap 2, and Tahap 3

lessonCards.description: Lesson cards assigning teachers, subjects, classes, and weekly period blocks

scheduledItems.description: Generated conflict-free scheduled timetable items across all days and periods

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was first created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last synced

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted admin registry document keyed by user UID

/timetables/{timetableId}.description: Synchronized school timetable workspace documents accessible across devices

/admins/{adminId}.description: Admin lookup collection for privileged access verification
